summary: Tested the company bank accounts feature (banche aziendali) on the backend and frontend. Backend: wrote 27 new pytest tests in test_iteration20_banche.py and all 27 pass. Frontend: tested Dati azienda, the invoice editor and the print copy (copia di cortesia) with Playwright; all requested flows work. One regression found: 3 tests from earlier iterations (9 and 10) now fail because they create a company with only `iban` and no `banche`, and the new Company validator wipes the IBAN.

minor.issue: Backward-compatibility regression. Company._banche always sets iban to the default bank's IBAN, or to '' when banche is empty. A payload that sends only `iban` (the old API contract, still used by tests in iterations 9 and 10) now saves iban='' without any warning, so the IBAN disappears from the XML, the scadenzario rate, the solleciti and the estratto conto. Failing regression tests: test_iteration9_scadenzario::test_19_iban_on_each_rata, test_iteration10_estratto_solleciti::test_01_pdf_admin and ::test_06_preview_A. Suggested fix: when banche is empty and iban is set, validate the IBAN with _iban_check and turn it into one default bank (for example nome 'Banca'), or keep it as it is. Alternatively, update those old tests to send banche.

The ABI/CAB mismatch error is raised in Banca's model_validator, so its loc is ['body','banche',0] with no field name. The duplicate-IBAN error comes from the Company model_validator, so its loc is ['body']. Neither maps to an inline field error in BanksCard; the message only appears in a toast. Suggestion: raise a FieldError (abi/cab/iban) so the error lands on banche.N.abi, banche.N.cab or banche.N.iban.
The Italian CIN character (position 5) is not checked; only the mod-97 check digits are. This is acceptable, just noting it.

integration_issues.flow: Invoice editor draft whose bank was later removed from the company
integration_issues.issue: form.banca_id still points to the deleted bank. The Select shows an empty value and saving returns 400 banca_id (only a toast). Suggestion: when form.banca_id is not among company.banche, fall back to the default bank or show a warning.

issues: The IBAN input (sm:col-span-2 of 6, max-w-3xl) is too narrow: a 27-character IBAN is cut off and the end of the IBAN is not visible.
BIC/SWIFT wraps onto its own row in a col-span-1 input, so an 11-character BIC is cut off ('BPMOIT22X'). Consider a 2-row layout: name + IBAN (wide), then ABI, CAB, BIC.
The legacy prefilled row (from the old iban field) shows ABI/CAB empty until the IBAN field is blurred or the form is saved. Consider applying fromIban when prefilling.
Scadenza uses the browser's native date input (existing issue, not part of this feature).

action_items: Decide how legacy iban-only payloads on POST /companies and PUT /company are handled (currently the IBAN is silently wiped), and fix either the backend or the 3 regression tests in iterations 9 and 10.
Return field-level locs for ABI/CAB mismatch and duplicate IBAN so BanksCard can highlight the field.
Widen the IBAN and BIC inputs in BanksCard.
Optional: in BankSelect, handle a stale banca_id that no longer exists in company.banche.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py has 2104 lines; it should be split into modules (company/banks, invoices, ...).
_bank_for_invoice re-snapshots the bank on every draft update. This is correct, but a draft whose bank was deleted now always fails with 400 until the user picks a new bank.
XML fallback at fatturapa.py:252: for an old invoice with no `banca` field, the XML uses the company's current iban. This is fine for legacy data.

success_rate.backend: 100% of new tests (27/27); 3 regressions in older iteration 9/10 tests caused by the legacy-iban wipe (2 further iteration 10 failures were only because no local debug SMTP was running)

seed_data_creation: Created company TEST_T20UI Srl (P.IVA 87999999001) and TEST_T87xxxxxx companies, with a client and invoices, through API and mongosh. All of it was deleted afterwards by company id. The DB now has 0 companies, 0 invoices, 0 parties, as before.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend/tests && pytest test_iteration20_banche.py -n 0. Valid IBANs: IT60X0542811101000000123456, IT61X0306909606100000012345, IT34X0200801600000100200300 (it_iban() helper in the test file). For the UI, run seed_ui_t20.py seed|clean; log in as admin and set localStorage fe_company_id to the printed cid. Tests in iterations 9 and 10 create a company with only `iban`, which now gets wiped.
rca of the issue: Company model_validator _banche ends with `self.iban = next((b.iban for b in self.banche if b.predefinita), "")`, so with banche=[] any iban sent in the payload is overwritten with ''.
